title: Deep Momentum Networks (Lim, Zohren & Roberts)
signal_frequency: daily; expanding-window recalibration in multi-year blocks
data_requirements: daily continuous futures price series with a documented roll convention
sufficient history for expanding-window calibration blocks
per-contract transaction cost estimates in basis points - the result is highly cost-sensitive
ex-ante volatility estimates for the scaling framework

sources.citation: Lim, B., Zohren, S., & Roberts, S. (2019). Enhancing Time Series Momentum Strategies Using Deep Neural Networks. arXiv:1904.04912; Journal of Financial Data Science.
Moskowitz, T. J., Ooi, Y. H., & Pedersen, L. H. (2012). Time series momentum. Journal of Financial Economics, 104(2), 228-250. (The strategy being enhanced; the Sgn(Returns) benchmark.)
Gu, S., Kelly, B., & Xiu, D. (2020). Empirical Asset Pricing via Machine Learning. RFS 33(5). (Independent confirmation that shallow beats deep.)
